$description: Component and interaction dimensions read from the Figma components (frames-components.json) and Foundations 03.5. They are not Figma variables.

button-h.$description: Buttons, tabs, nav items (Control / Button *, Navigation / Tab, Navigation / Item)

control-h.$description: Text field, search, select option, link, icon button; mobile minimum target

target-min.$description: WCAG 2.2 AA minimum; 44px+ recommended on mobile with 8px separation

focus-offset.$description: surface-colored gap between control and ring

12.$description: Component-internal inset/gap used by Consultation Slot, Navigation Item, Inline Alert, Toast (in Figma components, not in Dimensions)

20.$description: Report Record padding (in Figma component, not in Dimensions)

eyebrow.$description: NOT IN FIGMA: mono eyebrow and tag label size (11px)

eyebrow-line.$description: NOT IN FIGMA: mono eyebrow and tag line height (16px)
